title: B2B SaaS with GDPR
description: I'm building a project management SaaS for small teams. Expect ~5,000 users in the EU in the first year. Must be GDPR compliant. Budget under $500/month. Will need real-time notifications eventually.

title: Public REST API
description: We're launching a public REST API for currency conversion. Expect 10k-50k requests/day initially, growing 10x in a year. Latency must stay under 100ms. No user accounts, no sensitive data. Keep costs lean.

title: E-commerce with traffic spikes
description: Headless e-commerce storefront for a fashion brand. Normal traffic is modest but we do flash sales with 50x spikes. Handles payments via Stripe. Needs to survive Black Friday. Budget around $1k/month.

title: Health tracking app (HIPAA)
description: Mobile app where patients log symptoms and share reports with their doctors. US market, HIPAA required. Expect 20k users year one. Data is highly sensitive and must be auditable.
